title: Figure 2. Change in Centrifugal vs. Tangential Force of Orbiting Masses for HFGW Radiation
description: Two line diagrams: the left shows two masses A and B on an elliptical orbit of radius r with centrifugal force vectors fcf and Δfcf and GW emitted along the axis; the right shows a mass with tangential force changes Δft around a "GENERATOR'S FOCUS" with a lobed "RADIATION PATTERN". Caption: "Figure 2. Change in Centrifugal Force of Orbiting Masses, Δfcf, Replaced by Change in Tangential Force, Δft, to Achieve HFGW Radiation". Text gives HFGW power equation (1).
